name: Audiostock Inc.
summary: Audiostock Inc. owns and operates an online community platform where music creators can present and share their music audios. The company offers a platform for music creators to register their music and sell usage rights, receiving royalties based on sales. It also provides a marketplace for music creators to sell their work and for users to purchase licenses. Audiostock Inc. was formerly known as CreoFuga, Inc. and changed its name to Audiostock Inc. in July 2020. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Okayama, Japan.
